en: Dominate, win, and plunder. In a way, he is the personification of human nature. Rumored to be a sensitive softie outside the ring, inside he is a powerful tyrant.

A deep hatred of foreign fighters pushes this man to fight with all his might. His xenophobia is said to stem from some experience in his childhood, though nothing beyond that is known. If only he would fight everyone, foreigner and native alike, with such fervor...
A noteworthy fighter who boasts that his roar is capable of wreaking havoc upon everything around him. Those in the know say his presence is boosting attendance at the Underground Coliseum.

A skilled fighter and the quintessential Thai kickboxer. His unique kicking abilities have crushed the bodies and spirits of many a kickboxer. He plans on keeping up that fighting spirit in the Underground Coliseum, kicking his way through all comers who line up to fight him.

A master of ancient Ryukyuan martial arts. Said to be a master not just of the ancient style but also of nunchaku. After hearing about a tournament to determine the strongest fighter, he made his way to the Underground Coliseum all the way from Okinawa.

Once this giant of a man enters the ring, he won't stop his rampage until his opponent is down. His reign of terror extends beyond the ring, which has caused multiple run-ins with the law. His rampages will be put to good use here.

A powerful fighter descended from a long line of proud combatants. With his naturally powerful build, he can block the strongest of attacks and retaliate against his opponent with equally mighty blows. He came to the Underground Coliseum in pursuit of the fight money.

The man who ruled the pro wrestling world with his inhuman strength. He now participates in fighting competitions outside of the pro wrestling scene to prove that pro wrestling is the strongest fighting style. The Underground Coliseum is his final frontier.

Though he once stood at the top of the sumo world, his poor attitude and controversial statements angered his benefactors and led to his ousting. In spite of this, his passion for sumo wrestling has brought him all the way to the Coliseum.
This up-and-coming kabuki fighter has a strange motto: "A rain of blood is as valuable as a rain money." What will the crowd's reaction to his fights be? Roaring cheers or terrified screams?
He claims to be a descendant of Vlad the Impaler, representing a long line of vampires. His is a life of elegant ennui, and he craves but one thing: the thrill of the kill.

A man who glimpsed death and lived to tell the tale. Sustained only by his burning grudge, he has returned to life to fight in the Underground Coliseum. He seeks to win the tournament so that he may rest in peace, but that is not likely to happen soon.
The studly beefcake everyone's talking about. He's so suave that his very existence is a fashion statement. Fans eagerly await his first sacrifice in the ring, but he has yet to deliver.

A professional soldier who has had so many brushes with death, he and the reaper are practically on a first name basis. He'll take on any mission as long as he gets paid. When he doesn't have work, he goes to the Underground Coliseum to train.

This famous fighter is known for his giant sickle. Despite several wins, he boasts that no one has witnessed his true skill. He used to heave his sickle into the crowd when he lost, but the practice has since been banned. Dead viewers pay no money.

A man who runs a weapon modification business in Kamurocho. Despite his bulk, he moves with unexpected grace and precision while wielding his beloved weapon to deadly effect. He has come to the Underground Coliseum upon the orders of his weapon arts master, Shoji Yonashiro.

Everything about him⑬his past, his age, his motivations⑬are shrouded in mystery. However, his graceful dance in the ring is reminiscent of the style of a legend. It would not be exaggeration to say that this legendary man was resurrected in the Coliseum.

A man who doesn't know when to shut up. Having boasted on his blog that he is the strongest fighter in the world, he fights in the Underground Coliseum to prove himself to his followers. He's oblivious to the fact that it's against the rules to blog about the underground fights.

Taiga Saejima's fourth apprentice. A born narcissist, Tokita's hobby is looking at himself in the mirror. His conceit once drove him to ignore the plights of those around him, but Saejima has since rectified that behavior.

Higashino is a karate expert who made it to the Victory Road qualifiers. While he was easily defeated by Kiryu, his technique, developed using his own theories, has exceeded the traditional bounds of karate. He is accordingly a cut above ordinary fighters.

Shirosaka is a martial artist who makes a living hunting in the deepest reaches of northern Japan. Saejima taught him that his artless technique was easy to read. After losing to Saejima, he roamed Japan, working his way up the Victory Road ladder.

Banba is a powerful fighter, but his overconfidence led to a humiliating defeat at the hands of Akiyama. Following his loss, he vowed to train and overhaul his technique. He is both embarrassed by and grateful to his father, who awoke the fighter inside him.

The day Kongo turned five, he disappeared into the mountains with his father. By living in the wild, he was able to develop a fighting style that defies all convention. He is also a genius, having passed the Toto University entrance exam with ease.

Washino was once a promising pro wrestler, but an unfortunate accident forced his early retirement. After Shinada's encouragement, however, he re-entered the Victory Road tournament in a bid to restart his career. His dazzling aerial skills are very much alive and well.
Raiden boasts overwhelming strength combined with mastery of a variety of fighting styles. Nothing more is known about him, however, not even his true identity or country of origin.
After having run out of opponents who could stand against him at his full strength in the kickboxing world, he has come to the Underground Coliseum looking for better opponents.

This boxer was driven out of the boxing rings in his homeland after he was caught fixing his own fights. Now, he has come to the Coliseum to return to the ring. His light footwork and rapid punches have left a pile of KO'd opponents in his wake.

Muguruma was an instructor at a venerable karate dojo, but he sought further challenges. He has ended up here looking for those challenges in the Coliseum. He gets on well with Nobu Yamamoto, and the two of them have been seen having lunch together in town.

An out-boxer who fights like a bullfighter, constantly dodging his opponent's attacks until they tire themselves out. He came to the Underground Coliseum all the way from Spain after hearing about a tournament to determine the strongest fighter on Earth.

A young hopeful who rules the world of Japanese kickboxing with his weaponized knee kicks. He was the youngest person to break a number of kickboxing records. Now, no longer satisfied with aboveboard fights, he's coming down to the Underground Coliseum.

The head of a biker gang that operates out of Kamurocho. He defeated every leader in the gang until he stood at the top. He's joined up with longtime partner Shogo Usui to participate in tag battles and make his biker gang known to the underworld.

Leader of a gang of punks who call Kamurocho their turf. Many members joined his gang after witnessing his extraordinary fighting skills. He joined up with his partner in crime, Seiji Higuchi, to participate in tag battles in the Coliseum.

He and his partner Er-san are said to be the shining gems of the Chinese kung fu world. His numerous skills born from the unique stances in kung fu have an elegance not found in other martial arts. He has come to the Coliseum as part of his training.

He and his partner Yi-san are said to be the shining gems of the Chinese kung fu world. His numerous skills born from the unique stances in kung fu have an elegance not found in other martial arts. He has come to the Coliseum as part of his training.

A boxer who blew away the boxing world with his turbulent whirlwind of punches. He won countless title matches, each title belt preceded by a spectacular display of skill. He came to the Undergound Coliseum to participate in Tag Matches with Park Dong-ju.

A cleaner and the pride of the Korean mafia. He is well known for flawlessly executing his contracts. It's said that after he finishes a job, not a single speck of dust remains. To reinforce the status of his homeland in the underworld, he came alone to the Coliseum.

A silver-haired boxer known for his lightning-quick punches. He is not fighting tag team with his brother Kintaro Izaka this time. It seems they had a falling out over their outlooks on life, which led them to seek some time away from each other.
I need to get three marten pelts and give them to the guy in the village.
The village's trader needs a million yen worth of business from what I hunt and trap.
There are twelve Jizo statues on the mountain. I oughta pray to them.
I should get bear meat and bring it to Kihachi-han.
Let's find that time capsule buried at the Ghost Pine for that grievin' guy.
A guy and his old mother went to the mountain. I should check on them.
A woman wants some rabbit meat for her mother-in-law's meal. I oughta help her out.
Let's find an antler for that guy with performance issues. Gotta help a brother out.
This guy in the village wants me to hunt a gold stag. This better not be a wild goose chase.
Gotta collect three toxic mushrooms for that fella from Tsukimino.
Let's get Okudera-han to check my shootin'.
There's a rumor of a wild snowman. How's a snowman runnin' around on its own?
Let's find some bear fat for the woman in the village who has skin trouble.
A trapper went up the mountain. I should stop and say hi.
Gotta find a bear skin for that guy who ruined a yakuza's bear skin rug.
The trader said he'd pay double for a marten pelt. If I get one, it's his.
The trader said he'd pay double for a fox skin. If I get one, it's his.
The trader said he'd pay double for deer meat. If I get some, it's his.
The trader said he'd pay double for a whole deer. If I get one, it's his.
The trader said he'd pay double for a whole bear. If I get one, it's his.
Got the three marten pelts to the guy in the village. Glad to see him happy.
Finally sold the village's trader a million yen worth of what I hunted and trapped.
I visited all twelve Jizo statues on the mountain. Hope some good comes of it.
Got bear meat for Kihachi-han. Feels good to be appreciated.
Found the time capsule buried at the Ghost Pine. Ya gotta cherish your parents.
Rescued the guy and his old mother from the mountain. Ya gotta respect the wild.
Got some rabbit meat for that woman. They're an interesting family.
Found an antler for that deflated guy. Maybe it's worth a try.
Found a gold stag for the guy. Guess the legend was true.
